title: Sink-escape loop 2 (discs 4x as frequent): mar-40 Marangoni rods escape growing sink discs 2.5-3.5x as often as mar-0 rods (0.53/0.56 vs 0.15/0.22, 27-43 caught bodies per run) by real translation, and the escape environment cancels the cost of swimming far per cycle seen in the removal control (D gradient +0.02 [-0.13,+0.23] vs -0.32 [-0.68,-0.09]), but does not make it positive
summary: Same disc world as 20261026T2053-c45-marangoni-sink-escape with one disc per 50 t. Escape share of bodies caught by a growing disc: 23/43 and 23/41 at mar 40 vs 4/27 and 6/27 at mar 0 (seeds 90, 91). c00's mtips.py: the rear tip advances >= 2/3 of net displacement in 31 of 44 dividing rods in S vs 12 of 26 in I, and all 3-length movers translate. Pooled selection gradients of relative descendants on standardized traits: D +0.015 [-0.133, +0.225] in S vs -0.322 [-0.684, -0.086] in the removal control I; straightness +0.32 in S. Dividing rods in S swim 1.93-2.03 rod lengths per cycle vs 1.11-1.25 in I. Dense discs cut divisions (persistent splits 22-23 S, 14-19 I, 12-15 mar 0), so n is small. Two of the question's three criteria pass; distance per cycle is not yet rewarded outright.

finding.control: arm I (same disc stream, caught bodies removed at opening) and arm S at mar 0, seeds 90 and 91
